name: Fortune Teller
note: Madame Zara peers into her crystal ball and tells your fortune.
art_style: Kid-friendly magical storybook illustration, rich painterly style, glowing purple and gold light, full-bleed painting that fills the whole square edge to edge, with no frame, border, ring or circle drawn around it; keep the main subject in the central circle of the picture (the corners will be hidden), dark background, no text, no letters, no logos, no borders, square composition.

art.zara: Madame Zara, a warm, mysterious fortune teller with a deep violet head wrap with gold stars, big gold hoop earrings, kind sparkling eyes and a knowing smile, both hands hovering over a softly glowing crystal ball on a velvet table, candles and a starry tent behind her. Original character.
art.candy: A glowing crystal ball showing a mountain of wrapped sweets and lollipops spilling out of a trick-or-treat bucket.
art.bucket: A glowing crystal ball showing a sparkling lolly at the very bottom of a trick-or-treat bucket, like treasure.
art.ghost: A glowing crystal ball showing a tiny friendly ghost happily hugging a chocolate bar.
art.pumpkin: A glowing crystal ball showing a jack-o'-lantern with a huge happy smile, surrounded by autumn leaves.
art.brave: A glowing crystal ball showing a small child in a superhero cape standing tall under a full moon, with glowing stars around them.
art.laugh: A glowing crystal ball showing a family on a sofa laughing so hard they hold their tummies, popcorn flying.
art.costume: A glowing crystal ball showing a street of trick-or-treaters in costumes, with one costume shining with a golden spotlight.
art.share: A glowing crystal ball showing two children happily swapping sweets on a doorstep.
art.dreams: A glowing crystal ball showing a cosy bedroom at night, a sleeping child, a crescent moon and drifting stars.

style: mysterious, warm and theatrical fortune teller, hushed and dramatic, with knowing pauses and a twinkle of humour

scenes.title: A sweet future
scenes.line: Welcome, traveller... <short pause> Madame Zara sees... <long pause> a great big bag of candy in your future!

scenes.title: Hidden treasure
scenes.line: The spirits whisper to me... <whispers> the very best lolly is hiding at the bottom of your bucket.

scenes.title: A ghostly friend
scenes.line: I see... a little ghost following you home. <short pause> Do not worry. <chuckle> It only wants a chocolate.

scenes.title: Bright orange
scenes.line: Your future is... <short pause> bright orange! <laugh> You will meet a pumpkin with a very big smile.

scenes.title: Braver than you think
scenes.line: The crystal ball says... you are braver than you think. <short pause> Braver than a vampire at the dentist!

scenes.title: Big laughs
scenes.line: Ooh, I see... someone in your house will laugh so hard they snort! <snort> <giggle> Oh. That was me.

scenes.title: Best costume
scenes.line: The stars have spoken... <short pause> tonight, yours is the coolest costume on the whole street.

scenes.title: Sharing is magic
scenes.line: Madame Zara sees... <long pause> sticky fingers! <giggle> Remember to share your treats, darling.

scenes.title: Sweet dreams
scenes.line: The mists are clearing... and I see sweet dreams, full tummies, and a very happy Halloween. <sigh> Farewell!
